value.title: Review — 008 ddocs scan
value.note:
VERDICT: REQUEST_CHANGES. Final targeted integration-seam review PASS at d18bfd8e46cdb6cffdd26c8496f66353526620fd; fix-only corrective tree ACCEPTED at 588e709c32d7dd3ac21ea28fa46c364b7ed18c60; merge-base c6ad8b4d7b0710105b6b805bffe7027feb46b357. This accepts the implemented fixes and main composition, not shipment: fn-0004/ac-000c remains OPEN at system level, duplicate-content get failure and duplicate-text semantic collapse remain functional limitations, and false row/container spans remain user-visible. Named ownership and documentation improve disposition but do not turn open behavior into closure.

FINAL AC JUDGMENT: ac-0001 MET; ac-0002 MET; ac-0003 PARTIAL because duplicate-content paths break get; ac-0004 MET; ac-0005 MET; ac-0006 MET; ac-0007 MET for presented/current snapshots; ac-0008 MET for same-document assertion sets with cross-document rollups explicitly deferred; ac-0009 MET for presented corpus snapshots; ac-000a MET; ac-000b MET; ac-000c BLOCKED/OPEN with executable closure condition and named follow-up owner; ac-000d MET including missing, healthy and restart-unprobed states; ac-000e MET; ac-000f MET; ac-0010 MET; ac-0011 MET by PM-reported sealed 9/9 gate; ac-0012 MET; ac-0013 MET through exact refs-by-dd-address traversal.

CLEAN: all eight measured dd semantics remain satisfied — structural no-row-in-row walk; any string id is a row with open prefix metadata; positional addresses only; prose determined from schema declarations; no per-file ddocs links on scan/watch; validate-only health; not-applicable keyed on pressure relation; sweep_exclude indexes normally. Architecture remains clean: no new port trait, core views/types are pure, subprocess stays in daemon, store remains concrete sqlx, exactly one deliberate parser dependency and one ddoc forward migration (renumbered 0017 after main claimed 0014-0016), no refused trait-per-service/repository-trait/DTO-layer/mock/parser-or-PG abstraction. Hit.ddoc remains optional and absent on code hits.

INTEGRATION SEAM: full search bind map inspected and matches SQL/binds exactly: $1 vector, $2 model, $3 limit, $4 source, $5 distance, $6 repo, $7 path, $8 kinds, $9 worktree, $10 id_kind, $11 gate_open, $12 ddoc_schema. Anchor map is $1 model, $2 repo, $3 path, $4 worktree; AnchorScope makes all content predicates unrepresentable and hardcodes raw only for ownership existence. DdocHit moved to fs3_core::views::search without wire loss; daemon-private mapping preserves every field and code hits omit ddoc. Fresh integrated database applied 17/17 migrations; forward test applies 1-16 over an existing code row then 17.

PROOF: targeted integrated suites passed — pg_ddoc 15/15, search_scope_starvation 6/6, read_surface 26/26, daemon search tests 13/13, core view round-trip 1/1. Branch-built isolated smoke returned the stored-checked/derived-incomplete row under gate-open, returned ok empty with null empty_because under gate-closed, exposed worktree and schema_declared basis, and exact refs traversal returned the citing row with rel and JSONPath. Fresh database reported max migration 17 across 17 entries. PM-reported harness checks 9/9 and ddocs doctor 0/0 were accepted as user-provided ground truth and not redundantly rerun. Observed cargo 1.95.0, ddocs 0.1.0 and node 24.7.0.

value.finding: Two valid files with identical bytes create two file roots under one (blob, parser_version), and every get for that content fails as corrupt. Ddoc citations make the inherited identity defect materially likely; search also resolves a shared raw_hash to one arbitrary element owner, collapsing distinct rows with identical prose/metadata-excluded text.
value.note: Isolated branch-built repro: byte-identical a.dd.json and nested/b.dd.json were indexed in one root; both flowspace3 get calls returned FS3-E-STORE-QUERY-FAILED: blob 8f1e5a83... has 2 file roots, expected exactly one. PM independently reproduced the same failure for ddocs and ordinary Rust. This is pre-existing and does not require a parallel ddoc table, but it prevents ac-0003 from being universally true and is ship-blocking until separately owned.
value.receipt: target/debug/flowspace3 get a.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-a1b2 and nested/b.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-a1b2 -> identical store-corrupt errors after queue drained

value.finding: --gate-open/--gate-closed filter only the stored-state gate_terminal bit and ignore state_derived, so the stored claim wins the plan's headline query when the two disagree. DdocMeta::effective_state() is not used by the query layer.
value.note: Fresh isolated fixture returned state_stored=checked, gate_terminal=true, state_derived.complete=false with incomplete=[dw-d4e5]. --gate-closed returned the task; --gate-open excluded it. PM independently reproduced and confirmed this must be fixed by preferring derived.complete and falling back to stored only when derived is absent.
value.receipt: isolated target/debug/flowspace3 search contradictory completion --id-kind tk --gate-closed returned tk-b2c3; --gate-open returned no eligible content

value.finding: Derived-state enrichment is hardcoded to builder/plan done_when groups. Rows with valid derives edges to other sections or linked documents, including phase -> tasks, always return state_derived=null.
value.note: Live isolated search showed phase rows carrying rel=derives targets ending in #tasks while state_derived remained null. PM accepted this as a documented limitation pending dd's derive verb rather than duplicating recursive rollup logic. The limitation must be explicit anywhere derived-state coverage is claimed; ac-0008 is otherwise overbroad.
value.receipt: target/debug/flowspace3 search 'Contracts wave 0 PM authored' --id-kind ph showed derives edges with state_derived null

value.finding: The ddocs version is never stamped into persisted row/graph metadata and does not key re-derivation. A new probe updates only an in-memory snapshot; unchanged blobs are not enqueued, and even a queued known blob returns before re-enrichment. Schema, graph, gate, validation, or ddocs-version changes therefore leave stored row facts stale indefinitely.
value.note: The frozen u2 contract requires DdocGraph.version and ac-000c requires version-keyed clean re-derivation, but DdocGraph and DdocMeta contain no version. DdocTooling.version is ephemeral. DL-008 honestly records the parser-version enqueue defect, but the same path also defeats the new ddocs-version contract and the comments claiming the next add/rescan refreshes facts.
value.receipt: source trace: probe set before known-file loop; unchanged files skip enqueue; scan get_elements(Some) returns directly to enqueue_for_tree; no persisted ddocs version field exists

value.finding: Fallback embedding is not observable to an agent. DdocMeta stores embed_basis, but DdocHit and GetResult drop it; schema-list or individual schema resolution failures quietly produce fallback rows while is_absent remains false because only version is checked.
value.note: This violates ac-0005 and impl-guide risk r5. Isolated hit JSON contained no embed_basis. A healthy binary plus failed schema_names uses unwrap_or_default, suppresses all facts, emits fallback text, and omits the missing-binary notice. Surface embed_basis (and preferably schema-resolution degradation) and test the partial-tooling path.
value.receipt: isolated row hit JSON exposed schema/state/rels/findings but no embed_basis; code projection omits the field

value.finding: The second highest-value query, 'which tasks claim this criterion', has no relation traversal surface. Link fields are deliberately absent from embedded row text, search has no rel/target predicate, and refs stores only kind=file edges. The eval scenario can therefore pass only by incidental semantic similarity, not by the satisfies edge it claims to answer.
value.note: This repeats the capability-ownership hole the PM found for source-file refs. eval/ddocs/tasks-claiming-criterion declares a ground truth address, while crates/cli/tests/ddoc_eval.rs only validates fixture shape and never executes the relation query. Add an exact document-edge traversal/query surface or narrow the product claim and AC/eval wording.
value.receipt: full product-code trace found no inbound document-edge API or relation-target SearchFilter

value.finding: Every ddoc row and structural section container receives the whole document span. The summary policy uses span line count, so tiny rows and empty containers cross summary_min_lines and trigger avoidable summarizer work; empty containers also earn raw embeddings and remain searchable content.
value.note: Isolated output showed a five-line row snippet with span [1,15] and a smart summary; repo phase rows carry span [1,229]. Under real providers this converts a row parser into one paid summary per small row and can produce meaningless structural hits. Give rows truthful spans or base summary eligibility on raw_text; structural empty containers must not earn enrichment.
value.receipt: isolated target/debug search returned smart summary for a short row solely because the row span covered the 15-line file

value.finding: The persisted integration proof does not contain the promised transcripts for 'which ACs are open' or 'which tasks claim this criterion', and its missing-binary excerpt proves rows were served while the binary was absent, not that a clean corpus was indexed while absent.
value.note: The code and unit tests provide supporting evidence, but dw-002b/dw-002e require live end-to-end evidence and remain unchecked. Persist exact commands and complete result envelopes from an isolated zero-queue run before closing ac-0001/ac-000d/ac-0013.
value.receipt: exact search of integration-proof.md found none of the first two named query strings

value.finding: Dependency-state evidence contradicts itself: the plan/impl guide and eval resolution say dd PR #12 is open and file edges do not exist, while the refreshed task receipt says a real kind=file graph was recorded from dd main after PR #12 merged at 5aa18b7.
value.note: The current corpus may still correctly return an empty inverse result, but 'PR unmerged' is no longer a valid reason if the receipt is current. Reconcile the dated upstream state and preserve the stronger, corpus-specific empty proof.
value.receipt: repository artifacts contain both mutually exclusive upstream states

value.finding: The wave-0 frozen contract says Element.ddoc is Option<DdocMeta>, while the composed public type is Option<Box<DdocMeta>>. Boxing is a sensible allocation decision and the task ledger describes it, but the authoritative frozen contract was never amended, so reviewers cannot distinguish an approved ruling from silent seam drift.
value.note: Persist the contract amendment/rationale or restore the declared type. The implementation itself is architecturally sound; the finding is contract traceability under TENET 2.
value.receipt: direct comparison of frozen contract and composed public struct

value.finding: A legitimate zero-row ddoc filter was diagnosed as an unindexed repository, and the adjacent empty-result path then claimed ANN scan starvation without proving the content filters admitted anything.
value.note: Fixed structurally: AnchorScope represents repo/worktree/path ownership only, so content predicates are unrepresentable. Selective source/ddoc filters suppress scan_incomplete claims. Integrated live proof: derived-open returned the row; derived-closed returned ok with results=[], empty_because null, and no re-index or scan-incomplete steer.
value.receipt: d18bfd8 integrated branch-built daemon over fresh database; targeted AnchorScope, read_surface and search_scope_starvation tests green

value.finding: A daemon restarted against persisted roots began with no in-memory ddoc snapshots, but the user diagnostic flattened unprobed into absent and falsely claimed the healthy ddocs binary was unavailable; watcher jobs could also consume absent tooling after restart.
value.note: Fixed with boot-time root probes plus a tri-state accessor: indexing may flatten unprobed/absent, user diagnostics may not. Restart test and live rebuilt-daemon smoke were silent with healthy ddocs before any user scan.
value.receipt: 588e709 fix-only branch-built daemon restart over persisted roots; ddoc_notice_distinguishes_unprobed_absent_and_healthy_after_restart passed

value.finding: Conditional skip-path re-enrichment could not recover fallback raw_text and would retain same-version schema or graph changes by omission. A presented ddoc must consume the complete current tooling snapshot rather than enumerate invalidation reasons.
value.note: Fixed in code by deleting needs_reenrichment and unconditionally reparsing/re-enriching every presented ddoc when tooling is usable. Same-version facts-absent then facts-present test proves fallback text becomes schema-declared; unchanged current-snapshot test proves row text and hashes stay identical. fn-0004 remains open because DL-008 still prevents unchanged files being presented by the supported rescan path.
value.receipt: targeted ddoc_rescan 4/4 green; live remove+add presentation changed embed_basis fallback to schema_declared, while ordinary scan still enqueued 0

value.finding: #findings/fn-0001
value.rationale: CONFIRMED for ddocs and ordinary Rust. Pre-existing blob/tree identity defect with a named external owner. Duplicate-text semantic collapse was measured at 116 of 531 row addresses. Honest documentation does not make either behavior closed.
value.receipt: overall REQUEST_CHANGES; disposition carried to o-prime

value.finding: #findings/fn-0002
value.rationale: Gate filtering now uses derived.complete first, stored gate_terminal only when derived is absent, and unknown matches neither. Live stored-checked/derived-incomplete fixture returned under gate-open and not gate-closed.
value.receipt: integrated branch live and store regression passed

value.finding: #findings/fn-0003
value.rationale: Same-document derivation now groups structurally from the relation target trail and guards cross-document targets. Cross-document rollups remain explicitly deferred to dd's derive verb and return null, never false complete.
value.receipt: nonstandard-section and cross-document guard tests passed

value.finding: #findings/fn-0004
value.rationale: OPEN. tooling_version is durable and a presented job reparses correctly, but roots.rs still enqueues on blob change alone. ac-000c remains blocked until the supported path presents an unchanged blob and proves reparse/rederive without remove+add; PR #63 and its follow-up own the trigger.
value.receipt: live scan over unchanged indexed root returned enqueued:0; plan carries the executable closure condition

value.finding: #findings/fn-0005
value.rationale: EmbedBasis is present on DdocHit. Resolved schemas with zero declared fields stay SchemaDeclared; presented fallback rows reparse from current facts rather than retaining stale embedded text.
value.receipt: live hit exposed embed_basis=schema_declared; parser and rescan regressions passed

value.finding: #findings/fn-0006
value.rationale: refs accepts a fully qualified dd address and performs exact, unranked inbound traversal over stored relations. Eval ground truth now names traversal rather than prose similarity.
value.receipt: integrated live refs returned the citing task with rel and JSONPath; store/router tests passed

value.finding: #findings/fn-0007
value.rationale: PARTIAL. Row summary eligibility uses raw_text lines and empty structural containers earn neither summaries nor raw vectors. Whole-document row/container spans remain false and user-visible; positional JSON parsing is deferred.
value.receipt: empty-container vector/enrichment tests passed; live hits still show whole-file spans

value.finding: #findings/fn-0008
value.rationale: Persisted code, mutation reports, reviewer live runs and later integration tests now cover the behavior, but the original integration-proof transcript remains incomplete. Kept as an evidence-quality limitation rather than rewritten history.
value.receipt: reviewer live isolated transcripts plus targeted suites

value.finding: #findings/fn-0009
value.rationale: The corpus-specific empty inverse result remains valid, but historical PR-state wording is retained as dated evidence and is not current dependency truth.
value.receipt: recorded as documentation provenance limitation

value.finding: #findings/fn-000a
value.rationale: The implementation guide now records Option<Box<DdocMeta>> as an explicit third amendment with the allocation rationale and admission that the original frozen contract drifted.
value.receipt: beea122 contract amendment

value.finding: #findings/fn-000b
value.rationale: AnchorScope contains repo/worktree/path only; model_key is separate and all content predicates have no SQL slot. Filtered empty is a finished answer with no invented cause.
value.receipt: integrated twelve-slot search map and four-slot anchor map inspected; all scoped tests and live smoke passed

value.finding: #findings/fn-000c
value.rationale: Boot probes registered roots before serving and diagnostics use Option snapshots, preserving unprobed versus probed-absent versus healthy.
value.receipt: restart tri-state regression and rebuilt-daemon smoke passed

value.finding: #findings/fn-000d
value.rationale: Every presented ddoc with usable tooling unconditionally reparses and re-enriches from current bytes/schema/graph/validation; hash identity keeps repeat provider spend free. The separate presentation trigger remains fn-0004.
value.receipt: ddoc_rescan recovery and identity regressions passed
